reason: The exam question about our AI use is real, but I can't put an unaudited startup with zero customers in the execution path of customer trades. Our vendor risk review would stop it before I ever got to sign, and a free pilot still needs that review plus a letter of intent I'd have to defend.
objection: No SOC 2 and no customers, for something that sits in front of trades and payments and produces the evidence I'd hand an examiner. If that evidence comes from an unvetted vendor, it's a new finding, not an answer. And per-action pricing with overage is hard to budget when I can't predict agent volume.
would_change_my_mind: A completed SOC 2 Type II report plus one regulated US broker-dealer already running it in production that I can call, and a fixed annual price with no per-action overage.
